authorization: User explicitly requested cleanup and inclusion in the mod.
licenseNote: User-provided pixel redraws; no separate asset-license assertion is made here. Historical upstream design attribution remains in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
method: Read RGB8 PSD layers, ignore hidden visibility for individual exports, crop to document canvas, preserve hard white/transparent pixels, apply the two documented grid-based redraws, and save corrected editable PSD copies with one preview layer visible.
